# Dedicated combined M63 image. Build from the repository root with this file;
# Dockerfile.staging.dockerignore is the matching deny-by-default context filter.
# This does not alter the ordinary Site/FrontDesk Dockerfiles or enable flags.
FROM oven/bun:1.3.12 AS workspace
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json bun.lock ./
COPY apps/frontdesk-api/package.json ./apps/frontdesk-api/
COPY apps/frontdesk-web/package.json ./apps/frontdesk-web/
COPY apps/site-api/package.json ./apps/site-api/
COPY apps/site-web/package.json ./apps/site-web/
COPY apps/terrascope-api/package.json ./apps/terrascope-api/
COPY apps/terrascope-web/package.json ./apps/terrascope-web/
COPY packages/frontdesk-config/package.json ./packages/frontdesk-config/
COPY packages/frontdesk-database/package.json ./packages/frontdesk-database/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/package.json ./packages/neuvetra-database/
COPY packages/terrascope-config/package.json ./packages/terrascope-config/
COPY packages/terrascope-database/package.json ./packages/terrascope-database/
COPY packages/terrascope-calculator/package.json ./packages/terrascope-calculator/

FROM workspace AS web-build
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --filter site-web
COPY tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY config/typescript/ ./config/typescript/
COPY apps/site-web/tsconfig.json apps/site-web/tsconfig.app.json apps/site-web/tsconfig.node.json apps/site-web/vite.config.ts apps/site-web/vite.staging.config.ts apps/site-web/staging.html ./apps/site-web/
COPY apps/site-web/scripts/finalize-staging.ts ./apps/site-web/scripts/
COPY apps/site-web/src/ ./apps/site-web/src/

COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m80-contract.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
# Full web typechecking resolves this reviewed catalog; it is not a runtime corpus.
COPY data/research/answer-units/scope2-website.epa-acquisition.v1.json ./data/research/answer-units/
COPY output/pdf/neuvetra-m55-synthetic-electricity-bill.pdf output/pdf/neuvetra-m66-synthetic-electricity-bill-b.pdf ./output/pdf/
RUN bun run --filter site-web build:staging

FROM workspace AS production-dependencies
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --production --filter site-api

FROM python:3.12.11-slim-bookworm AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production \
    PORT=8080 \
    NEUVETRA_PYTHON=/usr/local/bin/python \
